jobs.title: Vice President of Product Design
jobs.description:
Job Title

Vice President of Product Design

Detailed Job Description

Job Overview

The Vice President of Product Design is responsible for leading the company's overall product design strategy, design organization, and user experience vision.

This role oversees product design, user experience, user interface, design systems, customer research, and design innovation across the company's products and services.

The VP of Product Design serves as a strategic bridge between business strategy, product management, technology, customer insights, and design, ensuring that products are intuitive, differentiated, scalable, and aligned with customer and business objectives.

Key Responsibilities
I. Product Design Strategy

Develop and execute the company's product design strategy in alignment with corporate and product objectives.

Establish design principles, standards, processes, priorities, and long-term design roadmaps.

Translate business and customer requirements into clear product design strategies.

Ensure design is integrated into product strategy and business decision-making.

II. Product Experience and User Experience

Lead the development of intuitive, consistent, and high-quality product experiences.

Oversee user experience (UX), user interface (UI), interaction design, information architecture, and customer journey design.

Identify opportunities to improve usability, accessibility, customer satisfaction, and overall product experience.

Establish user-centered design practices throughout the product development lifecycle.

III. Design Research and Customer Insights

Develop research strategies to understand customer needs, behaviors, preferences, and pain points.

Oversee user research, usability testing, customer interviews, surveys, and other research activities.

Translate customer insights and behavioral data into actionable product and design recommendations.

Partner with Product, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success teams to maintain a strong understanding of target customers.

IV. Product Development Collaboration

Work closely with Product Management, Engineering, Technology, Marketing, and Business teams throughout the product development process.

Ensure design requirements and user experience objectives are incorporated from product concept through launch.

Participate in product planning, prioritization, prototyping, testing, and product reviews.

Balance customer needs, technical feasibility, business requirements, and design quality.

V. Design Systems and Standards

Establish and maintain scalable design systems, visual standards, interaction patterns, and design guidelines.

Ensure consistent product experiences across platforms, products, regions, and customer touchpoints.

Improve design efficiency through reusable components, standardized processes, and modern design tools.

Promote accessibility, usability, consistency, and quality across the company's product portfolio.

VI. Innovation and Emerging Design Technologies

Lead design innovation initiatives that improve product differentiation and customer experience.

Monitor emerging design trends, technologies, tools, and methodologies.

Explore the use of artificial intelligence, automation, advanced prototyping, analytics, and other technologies to improve the design process.

Encourage experimentation, rapid prototyping, and continuous product experience improvement.

VII. Design Quality and Product Excellence

Establish design quality standards and review mechanisms across the organization.

Conduct design reviews and provide strategic direction for major products and customer experiences.

Identify design risks, usability issues, and experience gaps and develop improvement strategies.

Ensure product experiences meet appropriate quality, accessibility, usability, and brand standards.

VIII. Cross-functional Collaboration

Work closely with Executive Leadership, Product, Engineering, Technology, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Research, and other business functions.

Create effective collaboration mechanisms between designers, product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders.

Ensure design decisions support product strategy, customer requirements, brand positioning, and commercial objectives.

Represent the design organization in major strategic and product decisions.

IX. Design Organization and Resource Management

Develop and manage the product design organization, including UX designers, UI designers, interaction designers, researchers, design system specialists, and design leaders.

Establish organizational structures, resource allocation models, workflows, and performance objectives.

Manage design budgets, external design partners, agencies, tools, and other resources.

Ensure design resources are aligned with strategic product priorities.

X. Leadership and Organizational Development

Build and lead a high-performing product design organization.

Develop senior design leaders, design managers, researchers, and individual contributors.

Establish talent development, succession planning, career frameworks, and performance management systems.

Foster a culture of customer-centricity, creativity, collaboration, innovation, experimentation, and design excellence.

Qualifications
Education Background

Bachelor's degree or above in Industrial Design, Product Design, Interaction Design, User Experience Design, Graphic Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Engineering, Business, or a related field.

Master's degree or advanced qualification in Design, HCI, Product Development, Business, or a related discipline preferred.

Work Experience

Typically 17+ years of experience in product design, UX/UI, interaction design, industrial design, design research, or related fields, including 8+ years in senior design leadership positions.

Proven track record of leading product design organizations and developing successful products or digital experiences.

Strong experience in design strategy, user research, design systems, product development, customer experience, and cross-functional collaboration.

Experience managing multidisciplinary design teams across multiple products, platforms, or markets.

Experience working closely with C-suite executives, Product leaders, Engineering teams, Marketing organizations, customers, and external partners preferred.

International or multi-market product design experience strongly preferred.

Strong design leadership, strategic thinking, customer empathy, creative problem-solving, communication, collaboration, and organizational leadership skills.

jobs.title: Vice President of Product
jobs.description:
Company Description
Arbor Energy is an advanced energy technology company focused on developing next-generation power systems that provide reliable, scalable, and low-carbon energy solutions. The organization integrates aerospace engineering, oxy-combustion, and supercritical CO₂ technology to create high-performance power generation infrastructure. Arbor Energy is committed to meeting growing global energy demands while reducing environmental impact. Team members collaborate at the intersection of cutting-edge engineering and sustainable innovation, contributing to energy systems that support long-term industrial and societal needs.
Role Description
The Vice President of Product is a full-time remote role responsible for leading the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Arbor Energy’s advanced power systems. This role oversees end-to-end product management, from market discovery and requirements definition to launch and lifecycle optimization. The Vice President of Product partners with engineering, operations, commercial, and executive leadership to align product initiatives with company objectives and customer needs. Day-to-day responsibilities include prioritizing features, managing product portfolios, guiding cross-functional teams, tracking performance metrics, and refining product offerings based on market feedback and data-driven insights. The role also involves mentoring product managers, establishing best practices, and representing the product function in strategic planning and stakeholder communications.
Qualifications

Strong product strategy and product management skills, with experience defining vision, roadmaps, and portfolio priorities.
Demonstrated analytical skills for market analysis, forecasting, and data-driven decision-making.
Proven cross-functional team leadership and collaboration skills, especially with engineering, operations, and commercial teams.
Extensive product development experience, including translating customer needs into requirements and overseeing execution through launch.
Prior leadership experience in energy technology, industrial systems, or complex hardware/software products is highly beneficial.
Ability to operate effectively in a remote, fast-paced environment with clear communication and stakeholder alignment.
Track record of building and mentoring high-performing product teams.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

jobs.title: Director of Product
jobs.description:
We’re partnering with a growing B2B SaaS company to hire a Director of Product to lead a small product team and help build the systems, operating rhythm, and product capabilities needed for the next stage of growth.

This is a high impact player-coach role. You will set the product vision and roadmap while also getting into the work: coaching Product Managers, improving discovery and post-launch adoption, partnering closely with Engineering, and creating more leverage through better processes and AI-enabled product practices.

The ideal person has worked in an enterprise SaaS environment, has seen a company scale meaningfully, and is energized by stepping into a team that needs a strong leader to create focus, momentum, and accountability.

Location: Remote within the US. Candidates based in Central or Eastern time preferred.

What you’ll do

Lead, coach, and develop a small team of Product Managers
Set and execute a clear product vision and multi-quarter roadmap tied to company growth, customer needs, and commercial outcomes
Build stronger product-management practices across discovery, prioritization, requirements, launches, adoption, and feedback loops
Partner closely with Engineering to make practical roadmap tradeoffs, improve delivery predictability, and ensure the team is focused on the highest-impact work
Personally contribute where needed, including customer discovery, PRDs, user stories, workflow mapping, and product planning
Create accountability around post-launch adoption, customer feedback, and the business impact of product investments
Develop the existing product team while helping shape how the product organization scales over time, including future hiring, team structure, and capability-building needs
Work across Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and executive leadership to resolve competing priorities and move decisions forward
Establish an operating cadence that creates accountability, makes product decisions and tradeoffs more transparent, and helps the team deliver measurable improvements quickly
Build a high-performing, proactive product culture that takes ownership, communicates clearly, and follows through
Identify and implement practical ways for the product team to work more effectively through AI, automation, prototyping, data, and improved processes

What we’re looking for

10+ years of progressive product management experience, primarily in B2B SaaS or enterprise software
Leadership experience, whether as a Director, Group Product Manager, Lead Product Manager, or a senior product leader who has coached and elevated other PMs
Experience helping a B2B SaaS company scale through a meaningful growth stage, ideally from roughly $20M ARR toward $50M+ ARR
A track record of driving meaningful transformation within a product organization, such as improving product delivery, team performance, customer discovery, product adoption, or cross-functional decision-making
Comfortable operating as a player-coach who can lead strategically while still doing the hands on work required to move a team forward
Strong commercial instincts and fluency in SaaS metrics including retention, adoption, ARR, churn, and customer lifetime value
Experience working with enterprise customers and products that require strong security, reliability, and operational rigor
Demonstrated use of AI to create leverage within product work, such as research synthesis, prototyping, spec-driven development, workflow automation, or internal product tooling
Demonstrated ability to improve how a product organization operates, including clearer prioritization, realistic commitments, stronger discovery, and follow through on post-launch adoption
High ownership, urgency, and sound judgment. You know how to push work forward without waiting for perfect information or excessive process.

Benefits

Competitive compensation
Company paid medical, dental, vision insurance for employees
Annual profit sharing bonus
401(k) match up to 4%
Company paid life insurance
PTO
Paid maternity/paternity leave

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Payments & Platform
jobs.description:
We’re partnering with a well-funded, growth-stage technology company that helps businesses manage critical financial operations. They are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own a major product area spanning payment experiences, account services, platform reliability, and customer security.

This is a high-impact role for someone who understands the complexity behind financial products and can turn it into simple, trustworthy customer experiences. You’ll work closely with engineering, operations, risk, and external partners to improve how customers manage and move funds while helping shape the next phase of the company’s platform.

This is a hybrid position in the Financial District in NYC (2-3 days onsite).

What you’ll do:

Own product strategy and execution across payments, account services, and related platform capabilities.
Improve the end-to-end customer experience for receiving, sending, storing, and managing funds.
Lead product work across transfer experiences, payment workflows, account controls, and connected financial services.
Partner with Engineering on the systems and infrastructure that support reliable, scalable transaction experiences.
Drive initiatives related to account security, authentication, fraud prevention, and customer trust.
Work with financial-institution partners, payment providers, and other third parties to launch and improve products.
Partner with Risk, Compliance, Legal, Security, and Operations to ensure new features meet the needs of a regulated environment.
Use customer research, product data, and operational insight to identify issues, prioritize opportunities, and measure results.
Write clear product requirements, align cross-functional stakeholders, and lead delivery from discovery through launch and iteration.
Help set longer-term product direction while moving quickly on near-term customer and business needs.

What we’re looking for:

6+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex customer-facing or platform products.
Experience in payments, fintech, financial services, transaction products, account management, fraud, security, or another regulated product environment.
Strong understanding of how customer experiences connect to the underlying systems, partners, and operational processes required to support them.
Experience working with Engineering on APIs, platform architecture, data flows, reliability, and third-party integrations.
AI fluency and interest in using modern AI tools thoughtfully in product work.
Comfortable partnering with teams such as Risk, Compliance, Legal, Security, Finance, and Operations.
Strong product judgment, analytical ability, and comfort using data to make prioritization decisions.
Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across distributed teams.
Startup experience is helpful, or a clear ability to operate with broad ownership in a fast-moving environment.

Benefits:

Competitive compensation package
Stock options
Medical, dental, vision insurance for all full time employees
Weekly team lunches
PTO

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Consumer Commerce
jobs.description:
We are partnering with a fast-growing consumer technology company that is investing heavily in the next generation of its digital shopping experience. The company is hiring a Staff or Principal level Product Manager to own a highly visible consumer commerce business with the potential to become a major long-term revenue driver. This person will define how customers discover, evaluate, purchase, and manage a growing portfolio of physical products, digital services, and complementary offerings.

This is more than a traditional e-commerce roadmap role. You will operate with a GM mindset, connecting product strategy, customer experience, growth, revenue, margin, partnerships, and operational execution. You will work directly with senior leadership and own the strategy for scaling an early but rapidly growing area of the business.

The right person combines strong consumer product judgment with the ability to simplify complex systems into an intuitive, polished shopping experience. You should be equally comfortable setting a multi-year vision, presenting to executives, working through technical and operational complexity, and helping a cross-functional team ship quickly.

This is a full time, permanent position on a hybrid basis (Mon-Wed onsite and Thurs-Friday remote). The office is in Midtown near Grand Central.

What You’ll Do

Own the product strategy and multi-year roadmap for the company’s consumer commerce experience
Define a simple, cohesive customer journey across product discovery, comparison, purchasing, checkout, and post-purchase experiences
Lead new commerce programs and complementary services, including protection, upgrades, financing, and other customer lifecycle offerings
Identify opportunities to improve conversion, revenue, margin, retention, and customer loyalty
Partner with Growth and Marketing on promotions, acquisition, experimentation, and customer engagement
Use customer insights, behavioral data, and A/B testing to continuously improve the shopping experience
Work across Engineering and Operations to support inventory, fulfillment, order management, returns, and other commerce infrastructure
Evaluate and develop relationships with commercial partners, suppliers, distributors, and third-party service providers
Work closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Operations, and Customer Experience to translate strategy into shipped products
Present clear strategies, recommendations, and progress updates to executive leadership
Operate independently, make thoughtful decisions with incomplete information, and bring structure to a large amount of white space

What You’ll Inherit

You will join with a short-term roadmap already in place, giving you the opportunity to deliver meaningful improvements quickly. From there, you will own the longer-term strategy and determine how this business should evolve and scale. You will have dedicated cross-functional support, including front-end and back-end engineering, design, and data resources.

What We’re Looking For

7+ years of product management experience, including at least two years of meaningful Senior, Staff, or Principal level ownership
A track record of building high-quality consumer products at respected consumer technology, marketplace, subscription, or e-commerce companies
Deep experience with digital shopping, e-commerce, marketplaces, or other complex consumer transaction experiences
Strong product strategy skills and the ability to clearly articulate an ambitious vision to executives and cross-functional partners
Experience simplifying technically or operationally complex products into elegant customer experiences
Demonstrated success improving conversion, engagement, revenue, retention, or other measurable business outcomes
Experience launching and scaling products from early concept through mature operations
Strong analytical judgment and experience using experimentation and customer insights to guide decisions
Experience working with commercial, supplier, or technology partners
Ability to influence senior stakeholders and align Product, Engineering, Growth, Design, Data, and Operations
High ownership, strong executive presence, and comfort working in a fast-moving environment with ambitious timelines

Why Join

Own a business critical product area with significant long term revenue potential
Build within a high growth company at an important inflection point
Work directly with senior product and company leadership
Define a long term strategy rather than simply maintain an existing roadmap
Join a collaborative product organization with dedicated engineering, design, and data support

Benefits & Perks

Competitive compensation package including equity and potential bonus opportunities
Hybrid schedule with three days per week in the Midtown Manhattan office
Flexible working hours
Complimentary access to company products and services
Free daily lunch and a fully stocked office kitchen
Monthly gym reimbursement
Monthly public transportation reimbursement

jobs.title: Senior AI Product Manager
jobs.description:
We’re partnering with a well-funded, growth-stage technology company building a connected platform that helps businesses manage critical workflows, operate more efficiently, and make smarter decisions.

They’re looking for a Senior AI Product Manager to own a high impact area of the customer platform, spanning onboarding and activation, workflow tooling, integrations, and customer facing AI experiences. This is a great opportunity for someone who likes solving practical, complex product problems and can take ideas from early discovery through launch, measurement, and iteration.

This is a hybrid position in the Financial District in NYC (2-3 days onsite).

What you’ll do:

Own the roadmap for customer-facing AI features across a small-business financial platform, with a focus on making complex financial work easier, faster, and more intuitive.
Improve the new-customer experience, from signup through activation, helping customers reach value quickly and deepen engagement over time.
Build and enhance business tools such as invoicing, workflow automation, reminders, reconciliation, and other day-to-day financial operations.
Lead the strategy for partner integrations and APIs, turning basic data connections into useful, connected workflows across accounting, payments, payroll, and business software.
Identify thoughtful ways to apply LLMs, agentic workflows, and automation to real customer problems, balancing usefulness, accuracy, privacy, and risk.
Run experiments across onboarding, activation, product adoption, and retention. Define success metrics, use data to guide decisions, and turn successful tests into scalable product improvements.
Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Risk, Compliance, and go-to-market teams to bring products to market.
Communicate priorities, product decisions, and tradeoffs clearly across a lean, fast-moving organization.

What we’re looking for:

5+ years of product management experience, ideally in fintech, payments, SMB software, accounting, invoicing, workflow tools, or another complex platform environment.
Experience shipping customer-facing AI or LLM-enabled products. Personal projects and strong demonstrated AI fluency can also be considered.
Experience owning at least one of the following: onboarding and activation, invoicing or billing, financial workflows, APIs and integrations, or business software tooling.
Strong product analytics and experimentation background, including funnel analysis, measurement plans, A/B testing, and product instrumentation.
Comfortable partnering with technical teams on APIs, integration architecture, data flows, and product tradeoffs.
Clear, direct communicator who can work effectively with distributed teams in an async environment.
Comfortable in a startup setting where priorities move quickly and ownership is broad.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager

Hybrid - New York City
Base Salary: $225,000 - $275,000

The Opportunity:

Join an innovative company in the technology, information and internet industry building the next generation of AI development infrastructure. Help researchers, engineers, startups, and enterprises move efficiently from experimentation and post-training to reliable, production-ready AI systems. As Senior Product Manager, you will own experimentation and post-training products, shaping intuitive workflows that improve model quality, accelerate iteration, and connect research with production.

Responsibilities:

Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for experimentation and post-training capabilities.
Understand how ML engineers and AI researchers run experiments, compare models, diagnose failures, and transition work into production.
Determine where to build differentiated experiences and where to integrate with experiment trackers, evaluation frameworks, data tools, and model registries.

Must-Have Skills:

7+ years of product management experience, including at least 3 years building infrastructure, platform, developer-tooling, or machine-learning products.
Hands-on experience building products for ML engineers, AI researchers, or data scientists.
Strong understanding of experimentation and post-training workflows, including jobs, checkpoints, metrics, artifacts, comparison, reproducibility, and model evaluation.
Experience with post-training techniques such as supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization, reinforcement learning, distributed training, or hyperparameter optimization.
Experience designing or working closely with model evaluations and applying qualitative and quantitative signals to product decisions.
Technical depth across APIs, SDKs, execution systems, distributed workloads, observability, data and artifact management, and failure handling.
Strong product judgment and the ability to simplify technically complex workflows into intuitive developer experiences.
Demonstrated end-to-end ownership across discovery, prioritization, implementation, validation, launch, and go-to-market.

Nice-to-Have Skills:

Familiarity with distributed training, GPU infrastructure, or large-scale fine-tuning.
Experience with Weights & Biases, MLflow, Hugging Face, Ray, Slurm, Kubernetes, or comparable ML platforms.
